plot-caption: We report the fraction of norms that regulate information transmission, the contextual-integrity-relevant subset. The rate is essentially corpus-independent: 28.6% of fiction10 norms versus 29.1% of top100 norms (a 1.02-fold difference, JSD = 0.000). With the extractor held fixed, the contextual-integrity-relevant fraction behaves as a constant rather than a property of the reading list.
